s0201.literal: " On wuzi day the wine prohibition in Taiyuan and Pingyang was relaxed.
s0201.idiomatic: On wuzi day the wine prohibition in Taiyuan and Pingyang was relaxed.

s0202.literal: Because Jiang-Zhe's annual harvest failed, sea transport grain was reduced by four hundred thousand shi.
s0202.idiomatic: Because Jiang-Zhe's annual harvest failed, sea transport grain was reduced by 400,000 shi.

s0203.literal: On jichou day an edict ordered that military medical workers need only restore their wives and children, with households as before.
s0203.idiomatic: On jichou day an edict ordered that military medical workers need only restore their wives and children, with households as before.

s0204.literal: On xinmao day the Shaanxi Branch Censorate was re-established.
s0204.idiomatic: On xinmao day the Shaanxi Branch Censorate was re-established.

s0205.literal: On gesi day censorate officials and touring commissioners from each circuit said, "Provincial officials serving long terms intermarry with registered commoners under their jurisdiction, harming governance.
s0205.idiomatic: On gesi day censorate officials and touring commissioners from each circuit said, "Provincial officials serving long terms intermarry with registered commoners under their jurisdiction, harming governance.

s0206.literal: " An edict ordered mutual transfer among them.
s0206.idiomatic: An edict ordered mutual transfer among them.

s0207.literal: Zhihhehu was appointed to manage privy council affairs, and five temple-sweeping households for the Great Capital Confucius Temple were granted.
s0207.idiomatic: Zhihhehu was appointed to manage privy council affairs, and five temple-sweeping households for the Great Capital Confucius Temple were granted.

s0208.literal: On yiwei day remnant followers of Yunnan rebels who had not reformed were sent to the capital; Shejie's adopted son Aque was left in the territory to pacify the people.
s0208.idiomatic: On yiwei day remnant followers of Yunnan rebels who had not reformed were sent to the capital; Shejie's adopted son Aque was left in the territory to pacify the people.

s0209.literal: Pingluan was changed to Yongping Route, and Ganzhou was promoted to upper route.
s0209.idiomatic: Pingluan was changed to Yongping Route, and Ganzhou was promoted to upper route.

s0210.literal: One prison clerk in the Ministry of Punishments was established to manage prisoners.
s0210.idiomatic: One prison clerk in the Ministry of Punishments was established to manage prisoners.

s0211.literal: The Anxi Transport Commission added fifty-seven thousand four hundred ingots beyond the regular levy; each person was granted one set of robes to encourage their achievement.
s0211.idiomatic: The Anxi Transport Commission added 57,400 ingots beyond the regular levy; each person was granted one set of robes to encourage their achievement.

s0212.literal: An edict ordered that whatever money and grain of various offices has not been deliberated by the central secretariat must not be memorialized.
s0212.idiomatic: An edict ordered that whatever money and grain of various offices has not been deliberated by the central secretariat must not be memorialized.

s0213.literal: On gengzi day Puding Prefecture was changed to a route, subordinate to Qujing Pacification Commission; the former prefect Rongju's wife Shigu was made route administrator with tiger tally.
s0213.idiomatic: On gengzi day Puding Prefecture was changed to a route, subordinate to Qujing Pacification Commission; the former prefect Rongju's wife Shigu was made route administrator with tiger tally.

s0214.literal: Xuzhou Pacification Commission was made Xunan and Other Regions Various Tribes Barbarian Pacification Commission.
s0214.idiomatic: Xuzhou Pacification Commission was made Xunan and Other Regions Various Tribes Barbarian Pacification Commission.

s0215.literal: On xinchou day the Moon transgressed Eastern Well.
s0215.idiomatic: On xinchou day the Moon transgressed Eastern Well.

s0216.literal: On gengxu day the Hanlin Academy and National History Office submitted the Veritable Records of five reigns: Taizu, Taizong, Dingzong, Ruizong, and Xianzong.
s0216.idiomatic: On gengxu day the Hanlin Academy and National History Office submitted the Veritable Records of five reigns: Taizu, Taizong, Dingzong, Ruizong, and Xianzong.

s0217.literal: On xinhai day an edict ordered that impoverished military households be maintained and relieved for six years.
s0217.idiomatic: On xinhai day an edict ordered that impoverished military households be maintained and relieved for six years.

s0218.literal: Mongol students at the National University were increased by one hundred.
s0218.idiomatic: Mongol students at the National University were increased by 100.

s0219.literal: Eleventh month, jiayin new moon: Prince Azhiji's followers were granted two hundred thousand ingots of paper money and ten thousand shi of grain.
s0219.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jiayin new moon: Prince Azhiji's followers were granted 200,000 ingots of paper money and 10,000 shi of grain.

s0220.literal: Falconers on encircling hunts were ordered not to disturb the people.
s0220.idiomatic: Falconers on encircling hunts were ordered not to disturb the people.

s0221.literal: Shunyuan was placed under Huguang Province; the Sea Route Grain Transport Ten-Thousand Household Office was merged into the Sea Route Chief Grain Transport Ten-Thousand Household Office; two seals were granted.
s0221.idiomatic: Shunyuan was placed under Huguang Province; the Sea Route Grain Transport Ten-Thousand Household Office was merged into the Sea Route Chief Grain Transport Ten-Thousand Household Office; two seals were granted.

s0222.literal: Yiqibuxie bandit followers Wei Jie and others submitted; each was granted one set of robes, sent back to induce the chief rebels to surrender.
s0222.idiomatic: Yiqibuxie bandit followers Wei Jie and others submitted; each was granted one set of robes, sent back to induce the chief rebels to surrender.

s0223.literal: On dingsi day an edict ordered Datong, Jingzhou, Longxing, and other routes to transport fifty thousand shi of grain to Karakorum.
s0223.idiomatic: On dingsi day an edict ordered Datong, Jingzhou, Longxing, and other routes to transport 50,000 shi of grain to Karakorum.

s0224.literal: On jiwei day Venus crossed the sky.
s0224.idiomatic: On jiwei day Venus crossed the sky.

s0225.literal: On xinyou day there was tree ice.
s0225.idiomatic: On xinyou day there was tree ice.

s0226.literal: On jiazi day an order directed that monastic officials' crimes be adjudicated according to the twelve-article corruption code.
s0226.idiomatic: On jiazi day an order directed that monastic officials' crimes be adjudicated according to the twelve-article corruption code.

s0227.literal: On bingyin day Saturn transgressed Jinxian.
s0227.idiomatic: On bingyin day Saturn transgressed Jinxian.

s0228.literal: On wuchen day the Moon transgressed Well.
s0228.idiomatic: On wuchen day the Moon transgressed Well.

s0229.literal: On xinwei day Quanning Prefecture was promoted to a route.
s0229.idiomatic: On xinwei day Quanning Prefecture was promoted to a route.

s0230.literal: On jimao day the Moon transgressed Eastern Rampart.
s0230.idiomatic: On jimao day the Moon transgressed Eastern Rampart.

s0231.literal: Princes Mieqietu and Yulongtiemu were dispatched as envoys to Chaba'er.
s0231.idiomatic: Princes Mieqietu and Yulongtiemu were dispatched as envoys to Chaba'er.

s0232.literal: Twelfth month, jiashen new moon: an edict ordered that in inner circuits where harvests failed in successive years, those people already exempt from corvée should also have field rent remitted.
s0232.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiashen new moon: an edict ordered that in inner circuits where harvests failed in successive years, those people already exempt from corvée should also have field rent remitted.

s0233.literal: On yiyou day the capital wine tax was relaxed; poor people were permitted to brew wine.
s0233.idiomatic: On yiyou day the capital wine tax was relaxed; poor people were permitted to brew wine.

s0234.literal: On bingxu day Venus crossed the sky.
s0234.idiomatic: On bingxu day Venus crossed the sky.

s0236.literal: On wuzi day, for achievements in pacifying Song Longji, generals' ranks were raised and silver, paper money, and other items granted in varying amounts; each soldier was granted ten ingots of notes, released home, and maintained for one year.
s0236.idiomatic: On wuzi day, for achievements in pacifying Song Longji, generals' ranks were raised and silver, paper money, and other items granted in varying amounts; each soldier was granted 10 ingots of notes, released home, and maintained for one year.

s0237.literal: On bingshen day the Moon transgressed Eastern Well.
s0237.idiomatic: On bingshen day the Moon transgressed Eastern Well.

s0238.literal: On xinchou day the Moon transgressed Bright Hall.
s0238.idiomatic: On xinchou day the Moon transgressed Bright Hall.

s0239.literal: An edict ordered pacification and instruction of Shunyuan offices; unpaid taxes of the people from Dade year 7 were remitted.
s0239.idiomatic: An edict ordered pacification and instruction of Shunyuan offices; unpaid taxes of the people from Dade year 7 were remitted.

s0240.literal: Memorialized grants of official fields in Jiangnan and Western Zhe made by special imperial order were permitted to be reported back by the central secretariat.
s0240.idiomatic: Memorialized grants of official fields in Jiangnan and Western Zhe made by special imperial order were permitted to be reported back by the central secretariat.

s0241.literal: The Emperor's paternal aunt, Grand Princess of Lu State, was granted fifteen thousand ingots of paper money and three hundred bolts each of silks and cloth.
s0241.idiomatic: The Emperor's paternal aunt, Grand Princess of Lu State, was granted 15,000 ingots of paper money and 300 bolts each of silks and cloth.

s0242.literal: Zhenwu was further enfeoffed as Primordial Sage, Benevolent and Awesome, Dark Heaven Emperor.
s0242.idiomatic: Zhenwu was further enfeoffed as Primordial Sage, Benevolent and Awesome, Dark Heaven Emperor.

s0243.literal: On dingwei day the Moon transgressed Celestial River.
s0243.idiomatic: On dingwei day the Moon transgressed Celestial River.

s0244.literal: For the labors of transporting military provisions, Si and Bo prefectures and Tan, Heng, Chen, Yuan, and other routes had tax grain remitted for one year; Chang and Li one-third; gold-panning households and relay station households without seed or tenants were exempt from miscellaneous corvée for one year.
s0244.idiomatic: For the labors of transporting military provisions, Si and Bo prefectures and Tan, Heng, Chen, Yuan, and other routes had tax grain remitted for one year; Chang and Li one-third; gold-panning households and relay station households without seed or tenants were exempt from miscellaneous corvée for one year.

s0245.literal: The pacification commissioners of the seven touring circuits dismissed corrupt officials totaling eighteen thousand four hundred seventy-three persons; illicit gains amounted to forty-five thousand eight hundred sixty-five ingots; five thousand one hundred seventy-six cases of wrongful imprisonment were reviewed.
s0245.idiomatic: The pacification commissioners of the seven touring circuits dismissed corrupt officials totaling 18,473 persons; illicit gains amounted to 45,865 ingots; 5,176 cases of wrongful imprisonment were reviewed.

s0246.literal: That year, ten persons were sentenced to death.
s0246.idiomatic: That year, 10 persons were sentenced to death.

s0247.literal: Year 8, spring, first month, jiwei day: because of disasters and portents, an edict ordered the realm to care for hidden suffering of the people and reduce punishments.
s0247.idiomatic: Year 8, spring, first month, jiwei day: because of disasters and portents, an edict ordered the realm to care for hidden suffering of the people and reduce punishments.

s0248.literal: For miscellaneous offenses, those liable to the cudgel had punishments reduced; those liable to the bamboo were all exempted.
s0248.idiomatic: For miscellaneous offenses, those liable to the cudgel had punishments reduced; those liable to the bamboo were all exempted.

s0249.literal: Private salt laborers had one year reduced.
s0249.idiomatic: Private salt laborers had one year reduced.

s0250.literal: Pingyang and Taiyuan were exempt from corvée and tax for three years.
s0250.idiomatic: Pingyang and Taiyuan were exempt from corvée and tax for three years.

s0251.literal: Households affected by disaster in Longxing, Yan'an, Shangdu, Datong, Huaimeng, Weihui, Zhangde, Zhending, Henan, Anxi, and other routes were exempt for two years.
s0251.idiomatic: Households affected by disaster in Longxing, Yan'an, Shangdu, Datong, Huaimeng, Weihui, Zhangde, Zhending, Henan, Anxi, and other routes were exempt for two years.

s0252.literal: Dadu, Baoding, and Hejian routes were exempt for one year.
s0252.idiomatic: Dadu, Baoding, and Hejian routes were exempt for one year.

s0253.literal: Tenants' private rent in Jiangnan was too heavy; two-tenths were reduced on a ten-part scale, permanently fixed as regulation.
s0253.idiomatic: Tenants' private rent in Jiangnan was too heavy; two-tenths were reduced on a ten-part scale, permanently fixed as regulation.

s0254.literal: Mountain forest and river-lake prohibitions were also relaxed; people were permitted to gather and fish.
s0254.idiomatic: Mountain forest and river-lake prohibitions were also relaxed; people were permitted to gather and fish.

s0255.literal: On gengshen day because Song Azhong, associate pacification commissioner of Shunyuan in Yunnan, captured his uncle Longji alive and presented him, his rank was specially raised and he was granted one set of robes.
s0255.idiomatic: On gengshen day because Song Azhong, associate pacification commissioner of Shunyuan in Yunnan, captured his uncle Longji alive and presented him, his rank was specially raised and he was granted one set of robes.

s0256.literal: A Firewood Office was established for imperial cuisine; the Xuanzheng Court was ordered to manage it.
s0256.idiomatic: A Firewood Office was established for imperial cuisine; the Xuanzheng Court was ordered to manage it.

s0257.literal: On guihai day Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan's clansmen were placed under detention.
s0257.idiomatic: On guihai day Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan's clansmen were placed under detention.

s0258.literal: On yichou day ten counties were re-established: Suiping, Xincai, Zhenyang, Taihe, Shenqiu, Yingshang, Zhecheng, Chengfui, Jia, and Wuyang.
s0258.idiomatic: On yichou day 10 counties were re-established: Suiping, Xincai, Zhenyang, Taihe, Shenqiu, Yingshang, Zhecheng, Chengfui, Jia, and Wuyang.

s0259.literal: On bingyin day Censor-in-Chief and Court of Imperial Studs Commissioner Tasibuhua was made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat; Jiangnan Branch Censorate Censor-in-Chief Zhao Rong was made associate administrator; the Music Bureau was raised to third rank.
s0259.idiomatic: On bingyin day censor-in-chief and Court of Imperial Studs commissioner Tasibuhua was made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat; Jiangnan Branch Censorate censor-in-chief Zhao Rong was made associate administrator; the Music Bureau was raised to third rank.

s0260.literal: On gengwu day Nianzhenjianzang was made Imperial Preceptor.
s0260.idiomatic: On gengwu day Nianzhenjianzang was made Imperial Preceptor.

s0261.literal: On xinsi day an edict ordered: "Princes, consorts and princesses, and those on each route who have horses — one in ten is taken; princes and prince consorts going to Liaodong to capture eastern sea gerfalcons shall not be given relay horses.
s0261.idiomatic: On xinsi day an edict ordered, "Princes, consorts and princesses, and those on each route who have horses — one in ten is taken; princes and prince consorts going to Liaodong to capture eastern sea gerfalcons shall not be given relay horses.

s0262.literal: " From Rongze to Suizhou, eighteen river dikes were built; workers were granted ten strings of paper money each.
s0262.idiomatic: From Rongze to Suizhou, 18 river dikes were built; workers were granted 10 strings of paper money each.

s0263.literal: Prince consort Yeliegan's followers were famine-stricken; two thousand shi of grain was distributed in relief.
s0263.idiomatic: Prince consort Yeliegan's followers were famine-stricken; 2,000 shi of grain was distributed in relief.

s0264.literal: That month Pingyang earthquakes did not cease; restored civilian dwellings were damaged again.
s0264.idiomatic: That month Pingyang earthquakes did not cease; restored civilian dwellings were damaged again.

s0265.literal: Second month, bingxu day: National University students were increased by two hundred; selected from grand ministers' descendants on palace guard duty.
s0265.idiomatic: Second month, bingxu day: National University students were increased by 200; selected from grand ministers' descendants on palace guard duty.

s0266.literal: Zhuanglang Route was demoted to prefecture; Longgan County was merged into Deshun Prefecture.
s0266.idiomatic: Zhuanglang Route was demoted to prefecture; Longgan County was merged into Deshun Prefecture.

s0267.literal: On xinmao day Prince Chubo's troops were ordered to garrison-farm at Xuechu Hechu Valley.
s0267.idiomatic: On xinmao day Prince Chubo's troops were ordered to garrison-farm at Xuechu Hechu Valley.

s0268.literal: On jiawu day an edict ordered that talented fathers, sons, and brothers be permitted to serve together in the censorial system.
s0268.idiomatic: On jiawu day an edict ordered that talented fathers, sons, and brothers be permitted to serve together in the censorial system.

s0269.literal: The Jiangdong Jiankang Circuit Surveillance Commission was moved to Ningguo; Jiankang Route ledgers were ordered audited by supervising censors.
s0269.idiomatic: The Jiangdong Jiankang Circuit Surveillance Commission was moved to Ningguo; Jiankang Route ledgers were ordered audited by supervising censors.

s0270.literal: On bingshen day one thousand troops were dispatched to garrison Jiading Prefecture.
s0270.idiomatic: On bingshen day 1,000 troops were dispatched to garrison Jiading Prefecture.

s0271.literal: On jiachen day Hanlin academician and chief drafter Samarjin submitted one volume of the Golden Script 《Excerpts from the Veritable Records of Shizu》 and eighty volumes of the Chinese-script Veritable Records.
s0271.idiomatic: On jiachen day Hanlin academician and chief drafter Samarjin submitted one volume of the Golden Script 《Excerpts from the Veritable Records of Shizu》 and 80 volumes of the Chinese-script Veritable Records.

s0273.literal: On bingwu day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.
s0273.idiomatic: On bingwu day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.

s0274.literal: Soldiers' offenses of adultery, theft, and fraud were all referred to the relevant offices.
s0274.idiomatic: Soldiers' offenses of adultery, theft, and fraud were all referred to the relevant offices.

s0275.literal: Qe'elin households under Taizu's allotment were granted eighteen thousand two hundred ingots of paper money and ten thousand bolts of cloth.
s0275.idiomatic: Qe'elin households under Taizu's allotment were granted 18,200 ingots of paper money and 10,000 bolts of cloth.

s0276.literal: Tuochi and Talahai were granted seized Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan fields, sixty qing per person; close attendants' falconry qe'elin were granted twenty-seven thousand three hundred ingots of paper money and twelve thousand bolts of cloth.
s0276.idiomatic: Tuochi and Talahai were granted seized Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan fields, 60 qing per person; close attendants' falconry qe'elin were granted 27,300 ingots of paper money and 12,000 bolts of cloth.

s0277.literal: Grand Councillor Wang Qingduan was granted a jade belt and half salary for life.
s0277.idiomatic: Grand Councillor Wang Qingduan was granted a jade belt and half salary for life.

s0278.literal: Third month, dingsi day, an edict ordered: "Civil and military officials already appointed who, because the place is distant or the office low, do not take up post — their office is stripped and not restored.
s0278.idiomatic: Third month, dingsi day, an edict ordered, "Civil and military officials already appointed who, because the place is distant or the office low, do not take up post — their office is stripped and not restored.

s0279.literal: Military officers who leave their command without authorization shall all be sent back to their wing; violators punished according to law.
s0279.idiomatic: Military officers who leave their command without authorization shall all be sent back to their wing; violators punished according to law.

s0280.literal: Soldiers who return home privately without notifying their command shall be flogged and sent back.
s0280.idiomatic: Soldiers who return home privately without notifying their command shall be flogged and sent back.

s0281.literal: " On yichou day, last year twelfth month gengxu day, a comet appeared, about a foot in width, at eleven degrees of Room, entering the Purple Forbidden Enclosure; by this time it vanished — seventy-four days in all.
s0281.idiomatic: On yichou day, last year twelfth month gengxu day, a comet appeared, about a foot in width, at 11 degrees of Room, entering the Purple Forbidden Enclosure; by this time it vanished — 74 days in all.

s0282.literal: On wuchen day Left Vice Chancellor Shang Wen requested leave for illness; not granted.
s0282.idiomatic: On wuchen day left vice chancellor Shang Wen requested leave for illness; not granted.

s0283.literal: An edict ordered: "In counties and prefectures allotted to princes and prince consorts, darughachi shall employ only Mongols, rotated every three years per regulation; Han, Jurchen, and Khitan persons falsely called Mongols shall all be dismissed.
s0283.idiomatic: An edict ordered, "In counties and prefectures allotted to princes and prince consorts, darughachi shall employ only Mongols, rotated every three years per regulation; Han, Jurchen, and Khitan persons falsely called Mongols shall all be dismissed.

s0284.literal: " Order: escaped slaves of military and civilian households who are captured shall immediately be delivered to their master; if the master is elsewhere, he shall go to the local office to receive them; reward money for captured fugitive slaves shall serve as reward for the captor.
s0284.idiomatic: Order: escaped slaves of military and civilian households who are captured shall immediately be delivered to their master; if the master is elsewhere, he shall go to the local office to receive them; reward money for captured fugitive slaves shall serve as reward for the captor.

s0285.literal: Those who flee or entice and conceal shall be punished with varying severity.
s0285.idiomatic: Those who flee or entice and conceal shall be punished with varying severity.

s0286.literal: An edict on each route ordered: for sheep herding, from one hundred down to thirty, the government takes one; below that number do not take.
s0286.idiomatic: An edict on each route ordered: for sheep herding, from 100 down to 30, the government takes one; below that number do not take.

s0287.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Those appointed by inner edict — if truly close attendants on palace guard with long service, follow already-appointed ranking.
s0287.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "Those appointed by inner edict — if truly close attendants on palace guard with long service, follow already-appointed ranking.

s0288.literal: Those who served palace guard but lack office rank shall be ranked as miscellaneous officials; after one evaluation cycle, qualify as initial grade.
s0288.idiomatic: Those who served palace guard but lack office rank shall be ranked as miscellaneous officials; after one evaluation cycle, qualify as initial grade.

s0289.literal: Those promoted without qualification — demoted two grades; higher officials demoted by measure.
s0289.idiomatic: Those promoted without qualification — demoted two grades; higher officials demoted by measure.

s0290.literal: Second appointments under princes follow their jurisdiction's usage; after three appointments and above, permitted to enter regular selection.
s0290.idiomatic: Second appointments under princes follow their jurisdiction's usage; after three appointments and above, permitted to enter regular selection.

s0291.literal: Mongols are not subject to this limit.
s0291.idiomatic: Mongols are not subject to this limit.

s0293.literal: Yunnan Lizhou bandits robbed Yesudai'er's family property; the Xuanzheng Court was ordered to supervise local officials to capture them.
s0293.idiomatic: Yunnan Lizhou bandits robbed Yesudai'er's family property; the Xuanzheng Court was ordered to supervise local officials to capture them.

s0294.literal: Horses totaling thirteen thousand five hundred were supplied to Prince Chubo's followers.
s0294.idiomatic: Horses totaling 13,500 were supplied to Prince Chubo's followers.

s0295.literal: On gengchen day an edict ordered: envoys within and without on military business — upon arrival local offices provide provisions for fifteen days; other major matters eight days, minor matters three days.
s0295.idiomatic: On gengchen day an edict ordered: envoys within and without on military business — upon arrival local offices provide provisions for 15 days; other major matters 8 days, minor matters 3 days.

s0296.literal: All who serve as guard soldiers shall half be assigned to garrison farming; each garrison farming official and farmer was instructed to observe diligence and sloth for rewards and punishments.
s0296.idiomatic: All who serve as guard soldiers shall half be assigned to garrison farming; each garrison farming official and farmer was instructed to observe diligence and sloth for rewards and punishments.

s0297.literal: Fenning County was promoted to Ning Prefecture; Luzhou Route Tea Monopoly Intendancy was abolished.
s0297.idiomatic: Fenning County was promoted to Ning Prefecture; Luzhou Route Tea Monopoly Intendancy was abolished.

s0298.literal: Luan City, Jiyang, and other counties — frost killed mulberry trees.
s0298.idiomatic: Luan City, Jiyang, and other counties — frost killed mulberry trees.

s0299.literal: Summer, fourth month, bingxu day: a thousand-household post was established to garrison Dinghai against annual Japanese ships.
s0299.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, bingxu day: a thousand-household post was established to garrison Dinghai against annual Japanese ships.

s0300.literal: Yongning Route rebel Xiong Cuo came to submit.
s0300.idiomatic: Yongning Route rebel Xiong Cuo came to submit.
